question: Which research topics does the graph organise problems under?
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic) RETURN t.num AS num, t.name AS topic ORDER BY num

question: How many research problems are recorded?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem) RETURN count(p) AS problems

question: How many problems are open, partially solved, empirically open, or solved but impractical?
paraphrases: What is the status breakdown of the problems?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem) RETURN p.status AS status, count(p) AS problems ORDER BY problems DESC, status

question: How many problems does each topic hold?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:IN_TOPIC]->(t:Topic) RETURN t.name AS topic, count(p) AS problems ORDER BY problems DESC, topic

question: Which problems in topic {slug} have status {status}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:IN_TOPIC]->(t:Topic {slug: $slug}) WHERE p.status = $status RETURN p.title AS problem ORDER BY problem

question: Which topics have the largest share of fully open problems?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:IN_TOPIC]->(t:Topic) WITH t, count(p) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN p.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open RETURN t.name AS topic, open, total, round(100.0 * open / total) AS open_pct ORDER BY open_pct DESC, topic LIMIT 10

question: Which problems are solved, but only impractically?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem {status: 'solved-but-impractical'})-[:IN_TOPIC]->(t:Topic) RETURN p.title AS problem, t.name AS topic ORDER BY problem

question: What does problem {slug} state, and what is its status?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem {slug: $slug}) RETURN p.title AS title, p.status AS status, p.statement AS statement

question: Which papers are cited by the most problems?
paraphrases: Which papers underpin the most open questions?
cypher: MATCH (:Problem)-[:CITES]->(paper:Paper) RETURN paper.title AS paper, paper.year AS year, count(*) AS cited_by ORDER BY cited_by DESC, paper LIMIT 10

question: Which venues published the most papers in the corpus?
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper)-[:APPEARED_AT]->(v:Venue) RETURN v.name AS venue, count(p) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC, venue LIMIT 10

question: How many papers in the corpus appeared at {venue}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper)-[:APPEARED_AT]->(v:Venue {name: $venue}) RETURN count(p) AS papers

question: How many papers fall in each decade, counting only plausible publication years?
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper) WHERE p.year >= '1950' AND p.year <= '2026' RETURN substring(p.year, 0, 3) + '0s' AS decade, count(p) AS papers ORDER BY decade

question: How many papers carry a year outside 1950-2026?
paraphrases: Data check: which paper years look like identifiers rather than years?
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper) WHERE p.year IS NOT NULL AND (p.year < '1950' OR p.year > '2026') RETURN count(p) AS implausible

question: How many papers are not verified?
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper) WHERE p.verified = 'False' RETURN count(p) AS unverified

question: Which authors appear on the most papers in the corpus?
cypher: MATCH (paper:Paper)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(a:Person) RETURN a.name AS author, count(paper) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC, author LIMIT 10

question: Which institutions have the most affiliated researchers in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(i:Institution) RETURN i.name AS institution, count(p) AS researchers ORDER BY researchers DESC, institution LIMIT 10

question: Which problems are researchers at {institution} active on?
cypher: MATCH (i:Institution {name: $institution})<-[:AFFILIATED_WITH]-(p:Person)-[:ACTIVE_ON]->(pr:Problem) RETURN DISTINCT pr.title AS problem, pr.status AS status ORDER BY problem

question: How many recorded bounds are upper or lower, by kind?
cypher: MATCH (b:Bound) RETURN b.direction AS direction, b.kind AS kind, count(b) AS bounds ORDER BY bounds DESC, direction, kind

question: Which problems have the most formal bounds recorded?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:HAS_BOUND]->(b:Bound) RETURN p.title AS problem, count(b) AS bounds ORDER BY bounds DESC, problem LIMIT 10

question: How many bounds are stated in each model of computation?
cypher: MATCH (b:Bound)-[:IN_MODEL]->(m:ComputationModel) RETURN m.name AS model, count(b) AS bounds ORDER BY bounds DESC, model

question: Which topics carry the most impossibility results?
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic)<-[:IN_TOPIC]-(p:Problem)-[:HAS_BOUND]->(b:Bound {kind: 'impossibility'}) RETURN t.name AS topic, count(b) AS impossibility_results ORDER BY impossibility_results DESC, topic LIMIT 10

question: Which open problems have both an upper and a lower time bound recorded?
paraphrases: Where is the gap between known upper and lower bounds being tracked?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem {status: 'open'})-[:HAS_BOUND]->(u:Bound {direction: 'upper', kind: 'time'}) MATCH (p)-[:HAS_BOUND]->(l:Bound {direction: 'lower', kind: 'time'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.title AS problem ORDER BY problem

question: Which algorithms are state of the art for the most problems?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:STATE_OF_ART]->(a:Algorithm) RETURN a.name AS algorithm, count(p) AS problems ORDER BY problems DESC, algorithm LIMIT 10

question: Which production systems are named as state of the art, and for how many problems?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:STATE_OF_ART]->(s:System) RETURN s.name AS system, count(p) AS problems ORDER BY problems DESC, system LIMIT 10

question: Which theoretical concepts do the most problems rest on?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:RESTS_ON]->(c:Concept) RETURN c.name AS concept, count(p) AS problems ORDER BY problems DESC, concept LIMIT 10

question: Which problems rest on the concept {concept}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:RESTS_ON]->(c:Concept {name: $concept}) RETURN p.title AS problem, p.status AS status ORDER BY problem

question: Which problems list the most future directions needed to close them?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:CLOSING_REQUIRES]->(f:FutureDirection) RETURN p.title AS problem, count(f) AS directions ORDER BY directions DESC, problem LIMIT 10

question: Which problems are related to the most other problems?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem)-[:RELATED_TO]-(q:Problem) RETURN p.title AS problem, count(DISTINCT q) AS related ORDER BY related DESC, problem LIMIT 10

question: Which pairs of topics are most often linked by related problems?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Topic)<-[:IN_TOPIC]-(p:Problem)-[:RELATED_TO]->(q:Problem)-[:IN_TOPIC]->(t2:Topic) WHERE t1.num < t2.num RETURN t1.name AS topic_a, t2.name AS topic_b, count(*) AS links ORDER BY links DESC, topic_a, topic_b LIMIT 10

question: At which venues did the papers cited by {slug} problems appear?
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic {slug: $slug})<-[:IN_TOPIC]-(:Problem)-[:CITES]->(paper:Paper)-[:APPEARED_AT]->(v:Venue) RETURN v.name AS venue, count(DISTINCT paper) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC, venue LIMIT 10

question: How much grant funding has each problem received?
cypher: MATCH (p:Problem) WHERE p.funding IS NOT NULL RETURN p.title AS problem, p.funding AS funding

question: How many times has each paper been cited across all of computer science?
cypher: MATCH (paper:Paper) WHERE paper.global_citations IS NOT NULL RETURN paper.title AS paper, paper.global_citations AS citations

question: Which system is fastest on TPC-H?
cypher: MATCH (s:System)-[:BENCHMARKED_ON]->(b:Benchmark {name: 'TPC-H'}) RETURN s.name AS system, b.score AS score
